littleroot-town.name: Littleroot Town
littleroot-town.description: Begin in Littleroot Town. Route 101 leads north to Oldale Town.

route-101.name: Route 101
route-101.description: Poochyena, Zigzagoon and Wurmple live in the grass north of Littleroot.

oldale-town.name: Oldale Town
oldale-town.description: Continue west along Route 102, or explore Route 103 to the north.

route-103.name: Route 103
route-103.description: Explore the riverbank north of Oldale. Wingull appear among the grassland Pokémon.

route-102.name: Route 102
route-102.description: The wooded path to Petalburg City. Ralts and Surskit are rare encounters.

petalburg-city.name: Petalburg City
petalburg-city.description: Head west to Route 104 and Petalburg Woods. Your PC is available here.

route-104.name: Route 104
route-104.description: The coastal path passes through Petalburg Woods and continues north toward Rustboro City.

petalburg-woods.name: Petalburg Woods
petalburg-woods.description: Shroomish shelter under the trees. Slakoth is a rare sighting among the Bug Pokémon.

rustboro-city.name: Rustboro City
rustboro-city.description: Route 116 leads east toward Rusturf Tunnel and Verdanturf Town.

route-116.name: Route 116
route-116.description: Nincada and Whismur live along this rocky route. Look for the tunnel entrance at the eastern end.

rusturf-tunnel.name: Rusturf Tunnel
rusturf-tunnel.description: Whismur inhabit this quiet tunnel linking Rustboro's outskirts with Verdanturf Town.

verdanturf-town.name: Verdanturf Town
verdanturf-town.description: A safe stop beside Rusturf Tunnel. Route 117 continues east to Mauville City.

route-117.name: Route 117
route-117.description: Flower-filled grassland between Verdanturf and Mauville. Roselia, Volbeat and Illumise can appear.

mauville-city.name: Mauville City
mauville-city.description: The final town in this first Hoenn journey. Visit your PC or return to a place you've explored.
